title: Availability protections and capacity limits need deployment evidence
remediation: Service operators and maintainers identify applicable denial-of-service scenarios and agree on capacity, bandwidth, redundancy, upstream safeguards and recovery thresholds. From a controlled staging load or resilience exercise, retain configured limits, service and alert timing, failover or recovery observations, and treatment for uncovered paths.

milestones.title: Collect approved availability thresholds and a measured staging load and recovery record
